body.name: \(\mathfrak F_G(\mathcal O_G)\)
body.construction:
For observed blocks \(\mathcal O_G\), define the published compatibility fiber
\[
 \mathfrak F_G(\mathcal O_G)=\left\{(\widetilde P,\widetilde B,
 \widetilde\varepsilon,\widetilde\pi):\begin{array}{l}
 \widetilde B\in(\mathbb R^{p\times p})^M,\quad
 \widetilde\pi\in\mathfrak S_V,\quad
 (\widetilde P,\widetilde B,\widetilde\varepsilon,
 \widetilde\pi)\in\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{pub}},\\
 \operatorname{Cov}_{\widetilde P}(\widetilde X^{(a)},
 \widetilde X^{(b)})=\Sigma^{ab}
 \text{ whenever }a=b\text{ or }\{a,b\}\in E
 \end{array}\right\}.
\]
Here \(\widetilde X\) is the endogenous vector family governed by the displayed published-class mechanism. In particular, neither \(\widetilde B\) nor \(\widetilde\pi\) is fixed to a modified-Cholesky construction in the definition of the fiber.
